check: Firing every 15 seconds gives 60/15 = 4 firings per minute, each lasting 5 seconds, so 4 × 5 = 20 seconds of flames. The solution incorrectly adds the flame duration to the stated firing interval.
error_description: The solution changes the firing interval from 15 seconds to 20 seconds by adding the 5-second flame duration. This produces an incorrect rate and final answer of 15 seconds per minute.
